navtara.howBody: Use dasha, gochara and natal placement to confirm what will happen. Use Navtara to read the nature of the experience and your decision window (Vipat / Pratyari / Vadha call for extra caution). Gochara without a supporting dasha brings only energy, not events.

taramandal.intro: Taramandal is different from Navtara. Every nakshatra belongs to one or more constellation groups, and planets placed in a group take on that mandal’s cosmic role.
taramandal.unmapped: This star isn’t yet mapped to a complete Taramandal in the current teaching set.
taramandal.emptyChart: Under the taught memberships, no complete mandal currently holds the Moon, Lagna or a core planet in this chart.
taramandal.taughtLead: {count} taught mandals · each nakshatra belongs to a constellation group the way a member serves a king.
taramandal.notNavtaraBody: Navtara counts nine tara steps outward from the birth star. Taramandal works differently: fixed constellation groups that each hold nakshatras as members. When planets fall within a mandal, what they signify takes on that group’s cosmic energy — which can produce patterns sometimes mistaken for stelliums.
taramandal.coverageBody: The only remaining gaps are the upcoming Mrityu Karma and Gyan mandals (their kings are recorded; the full groups are pending). Partial members in other mandals still count.

viz.specialCaption: Your birth star sits at the top; the wheel runs through all 27 stars. Gold marks the Janma star, rose the hard stars, amber the sensitive ones. Natal planets sit inside the ring; today's transits on special stars sit outside.
viz.webCaption: Each arrow runs from a planet to the lord of its star. Larger gold nodes govern two or more placements; a teal loop means a planet sits in its own star; gold arrows are star exchanges. The Lagna is at the centre.
viz.timelineCaption: Teal bars are the days the Moon is in your birth star; gold diamonds are star birthdays. The black line is today.
viz.lattaCaption: Arrows run from each planet's star to the star it kicks. Solid arrows kick forward, dashed ones backward. Rose arrows land on your Janma (gold) or Lagna (teal) star.
viz.stripCaption: All twelve signs from 0° Aries to 30° Pisces. Rose zones are the Gandanta knots; teal ticks are each sign's Pushkara Bhaga and rose ticks its Mrityu Bhaga. Planets with any flag are ringed in gold.

special.title: Special stars from your birth star
special.lead: Counting from the Moon's star (1 = Janma), certain stars carry a fixed meaning for you. Planets placed in them at birth colour that theme for life; transits over them time it.

janma.name: Janma
janma.meaning: Body, health and the self. Whatever touches this star touches you directly.

karma.name: Karma
karma.meaning: Work, action and reputation. The 10th star works like a 10th house of the stars.

sanghatika.name: Sanghatika
sanghatika.meaning: Associations and groups. Hard transits here bring trouble through company, partners or crowds.

samudaya.name: Samudaya
samudaya.meaning: Collective events and gatherings. Hard transits bring mishaps in public or shared undertakings.

adhana.name: Adhana
adhana.meaning: Conception and foundations; the third trine of the Janma star. Shows what you build and carry forward.

vainashika.name: Vainashika
vainashika.meaning: The star of loss and endings. Malefic transits here call for caution with health, money and risky starts.

manasa.name: Manasa
manasa.meaning: Mind and feelings. Transits colour mood, worry and peace of mind.

special.transitTitle: Transits over your special stars now
special.transitLead: Hard planets (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) on a hard star call for care; on a sensitive star they need attention. Benefics on any special star support its theme.
special.transitNone: No planet is transiting a special star today.
special.note: Texts disagree on Vainashika (22nd or 23rd) and on the Jati, Desha and Abhisheka stars used for kings, so those are not shown.

starlord.title: Star-lord chain
starlord.lead: A planet gives the results of the lord of the nakshatra it occupies. Read each row as: this planet acts through its star lord, so it delivers the houses that lord sits in and rules.
starlord.loadLead: A star lord that governs several planets becomes a hidden manager of the chart. Its dasha and its strength decide how those planets perform.
starlord.loadLine: {lord} governs {count, plural, one {# placement} other {# placements}}: {bodies}
starlord.exchangeLead: When two planets sit in each other's stars, they work as one unit and their dashas run each other's results.
starlord.exchangeNone: No star exchange in this chart.

birthday.title: Star birthday (Janma Nakshatra Dinam)
birthday.lead: The Vedic birthday is the day the Moon returns to your birth star while the Sun is in its natal sign ({sign}). It is a day for prayer, charity and blessings from elders.
birthday.failed: Could not calculate the star birthdays.
birthday.none: The Moon does not reach your star in this solar month.
birthday.twice: The star falls twice this solar month. Family custom decides which one to keep; many keep the one with the star at sunrise.
birthday.returnsLead: Each month the Moon passes through your birth star for about a day. Many avoid big new starts then and keep it for prayer and rest.
birthday.timesNote: Times are in your device's time zone.

latta.title: Latta — the stars each planet kicks
latta.lead: Muhurta Chintamani: the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn kick a star ahead of them; the Moon, Venus, Mercury and Rahu kick one behind. A kicked star is weakened for new beginnings.
latta.natalTitle: Natal kicks on your Janma and Lagna stars
latta.transitTitle: Today's kicks on your Janma and Lagna stars
latta.noneNatal: No natal planet kicks your Janma or Lagna star.
latta.noneTransit: No transit planet kicks your Janma or Lagna star today.

meanings.Ju: Loss of support from family and mentors

degrees.title: Sensitive degrees
degrees.lead: The exact degree inside a star can matter as much as the star itself. These checks flag knots, blessed degrees, danger degrees and star edges.

explain.gandanta: Gandanta: the knot where a water sign ends and a fire sign begins (Revati–Ashwini, Ashlesha–Magha, Jyeshtha–Mula). It brings karmic intensity and turning points.
explain.pushkaraNavamsha: Pushkara Navamsha: a nourishing navamsha that strengthens and protects the planet.
explain.pushkaraBhaga: Pushkara Bhaga: the single most auspicious degree of the sign (within 1°).
explain.mrityuBhaga: Mrityu Bhaga: a classical danger degree. Read it as a point of strain and transformation, never on its own as a verdict.
explain.sandhi: Nakshatra sandhi: within 0.5° of a star boundary. A small error in birth time can move the planet into the next star, so check the time before relying on its star.
